d: enior Sales Manager, Network Control Solutions (SCADA, EMS, DMS, OMS, ADMS)
Reporting Line: Middle East and Africa - Head of Sales for Network Control Solution Line

Hitachi Energy is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Sales Manager to drive growth of Network Control solutions across the Middle East and Africa. The role focuses on SCADA, EMS, DMS, OMS, ADMS, Generation, Transmission and Distribution applications, building long-term customer relationships, leading strategic pursuits and closing complex utility projects. The ideal candidate must possess deep domain expertise in Network Control and utility operations and be capable of engaging utility executives, delivering compelling presentations and leading commercial negotiations.
Deliver order intake, revenue and profitability targets for Network Control solutions and services.
Develop and maintain executive-level customer relationships.
Lead opportunity qualification, pursuit strategy, offer preparation, negotiations, closure and booking.
Drive market development across MEA and identify new opportunities.
Coordinate with technical experts, bid managers and account teams.
Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM reporting and business reviews.
Support marketing and thought leadership activities.
q: Bachelor degree in Electrical, Electronics, Automation, Power Systems Engineering or equivalent.
Minimum 10 years within the power and energy industry.
Minimum 7 years in Grid Automation, Power Systems or Digital Utility solution sales.
Minimum 5 years selling Network Control solutions including SCADA, EMS, DMS/ADMS, OMS and Generation Management Systems.
Extensive knowledge of Generation, Transmission and Distribution operations is mandatory.
Applicants must possess direct and substantial experience in Network Control, SCADA, EMS, DMS, OMS, ADMS or closely related utility software domains.
Applicants with non-relevant industry or product experience will not be considered.
Proven customer-facing experience including executive presentations, solution workshops and commercial negotiations.
Demonstrated track record closing large-scale utility digitalization projects.
Fluency in French and English is mandatory. Arabic is highly desirable.
Ability to conduct presentations and negotiations in French and English.
Traveling expectancy across the Middle East and Africa.

d: The Purchasing Agent is responsible for planning, sourcing, and procuring materials, equipment, and services required for the successful execution of construction projects. The role ensures that procurement activities are carried out efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with project specifications, company policies, and quality standards. Working closely with project teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, the Purchasing Agent manages supplier relationships, obtains competitive quotations, issues purchase orders, monitors deliveries, resolves procurement-related issues, and maintains accurate purchasing records to support project timelines and organizational objectives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Procurement, or a related field.
Minimum 3–5 years of procurement or purchasing experience, preferably within the construction industry.
Strong knowledge of procurement processes, purchasing practices, and supplier management.
Familiarity with construction materials, equipment, and vendor markets.
Proven ability to negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms with suppliers.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate supplier performance and purchasing requirements.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective coordination with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple procurement activities simultaneously.
High level of attention to detail and accuracy in purchase orders, contracts, and procurement documentation.
Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and support project delivery objectives.
Sound understanding of company policies, compliance requirements, and procurement best practices.
